name: templates-dir-layout
body:
`templates/` layout (fixed):
```
templates/
  library.yaml                  # name, description, format: 1
  AGENTS.md                     # inert agent guide (ignored; see library-guide-layout)
  slides/<name>/   template.yaml, layout.html.tmpl, example.md
  sections/<name>/ template.yaml, layout.html.tmpl, example.md
  themes/<name>/   theme.css (+ fonts/, logos)
  media/…          any type (images, video, fonts)
```
- `library.yaml`: `name` identifier `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*`, optional `description`, `format: 1` (layout/manifest format version, required).
- `slides/<name>/` holds one slide template; `sections/<name>/` holds one section template. Each holds `template.yaml` (schema manifest), `layout.html.tmpl` (Go html/template layout, see template-language) and `example.md` (example slide source).
- A template's kind (slide|section) is determined solely by the directory it lives in; `template.yaml` has no `usage:` key (its presence = templates error).
- A template's name is its directory name and must be unique across `slides/` and `sections/` together (section template names are used as field types, see field-types); a duplicate name = templates error naming both paths.
- `themes/<name>/` one directory per theme holding `theme.css` (token stylesheet) and optional theme-owned files (fonts, logos); a theme's name is its directory name. Theme-owned files are referenced only from that `theme.css` via relative `url()` and served from the theme directory; they are not reachable via the layout `media` helper. A `theme.css` — and any CSS it `@import`s from within its own theme directory — may also reference the resolved library's shared `media/` tree with the reserved `media:` URL prefix (theme-media-references); it still cannot reach another theme's directory or anything outside the library.
- `media/` optional shared media of any type (fonts, logos, images, video, …); the base for the layout `media ""path""` helper (path relative to `templates/media/`, no `..`, no absolute paths) and for the reserved `media:` URL prefix in theme CSS (theme-media-references).
- Top-level entries other than the documented structure (`library.yaml`, `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/`, `media/`) are ignored: the loader validates only the library itself, so an unrelated entry — a `.git/` directory (a library is often a git repo), a `README.md`, a root-level `AGENTS.md` (library/template-author agent guide, library-guide-layout), an editor lockfile — never blocks a load. Ignored entries are inert: never parsed, validated, rendered, listed or served, and not template assets.
- The layout above is rooted at the resolved library root (see external-template-library): either the configured `templates:` path (relative to the deck root, or absolute) or the local `templates/`. The layout itself is unchanged — only its root is resolved.
AC: a directory following this layout loads; each deviation within the library structure (`usage:` key, cross-kind duplicate name, missing file) yields a templates error naming the offending path; an unrelated top-level entry (`.git/`, `README.md`, an editor lockfile, …) is ignored.
